verdicts.title: A class of non-holomorphic modular forms I
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This introductory paper studies a class of real analytic functions on the upper half plane satisfying a certain modular transformation property. They are not eigenfunctions of the Laplacian and are quite distinct from Maass forms. verdicts.title: From modular forms to differential equations for Feynman integrals
